evidence_rows.observation: Zemaira is CSL's Alpha-1-Proteinase Inhibitor(Human), BLA125078; Purple Book lists351(a) IV1g/4g/5g single-dose presentations and original approval2003-07-08.
evidence_rows.limitation: This is manufacturing/regulatory precedent for the labeled product, not a purchased lot, independent license, price or EVLP indication.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Qualification can start from a defined manufactured article; no automatic generic-drug asset or regulatory reliance route is established.

evidence_rows.observation: The current-linked January2024 label restricts the stated use to IV augmentation in deficient adults with emphysema, and specifies administration within3h after reconstitution without mixing other medicinal products.
evidence_rows.limitation: These directions do not establish12h warm EVLP stability, activity or compatibility; they do not themselves prove the research mixture is harmful.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: The originally priced formulation/potency/process qualification remains a real task.

evidence_rows.observation: The original US application has70 numbered positions with cancellations. Claims1–2 address normothermic AAT organ perfusion and transplantation; claim55 covers an AAT/albumin/dextran/salt perfusion composition.
evidence_rows.limitation: Publication is not a US grant or adjudicated infringement map.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Known-use novelty and potential rights relevance persist; do not call formulation qualification an already exclusive product.

evidence_rows.observation: Google displays Pending, with its last displayed US prosecution event a2022-12-16 final rejection. Official Patent Center yielded no readable record; Global Dossier onlyLoading, and assignment retrieval failed.
evidence_rows.limitation: Neither current pendency nor abandonment is primary-verified. A conflicting secondary discovery hint was not promoted to a legal fact.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain an unresolved current-US-status field; neither a grant nor clearance can be inferred.

evidence_rows.observation: AU B2's22 numbered claims narrow independent claims1–2 to human lungs, normothermia,6–12h and8–12mg/mL AAT; claim2 includes transplantation. The original front records accepted-journal date2024-01-04.
evidence_rows.limitation: Current enforceability and title chain remain unverified. Exact claim conditions do not establish a safe design-around or dosing optimum.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Replace application-only shorthand with a territory/version-specific rights record, preserving that Round2 already listed the grant.

evidence_rows.observation: KR original front reports registration2022-06-16, publication2022-06-22 and58 total claims; numbered positions extend through70 with deletions. English-rendered claim1 addresses ventilated normothermic AAT lung perfusion.
evidence_rows.limitation: English text is machine translated; original pages were inspected without an independent legal translation. Current maintenance/title not established.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: A granted family member exists, but it does not resolve US rights or global commercial freedom.

evidence_rows.observation: Round2 already stated that related AU/KR grants were listed.
evidence_rows.limitation: Later summaries focused on the US application; that does not erase the earlier recorded grants.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Round22 adds claim/version inspection and counting corrections, not a false first-discovery claim.

evidence_rows.observation: Official UHN Zemaira protocol23-5745/control294199 lists Not yet recruiting at update2026-07-18, trial authorization/no-objection date2025-02-27, phaseOther and No registry match found.
evidence_rows.limitation: Displayed status is not independently verified recruitment activity; the approval field refers to trial regulatory requirements, not marketing approval.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: An adjacent clinical development effort exists; no completed efficacy or execution-ready partnership is inferred.

evidence_rows.observation: The official summary does not supply an EVLP-only versus recipient-systemic route, enrollment denominator or trial results.
evidence_rows.limitation: No full protocol or matched results record was recovered in this bounded search; this is not a global claim that none exists.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not assign the clinical effort to the proposed ex-vivo-only product or pool it with declined-donor physiology.

evidence_rows.observation: Example12 describes possible human perfusion/transplantation and optional recipientIV AAT; it is distinct from the five-donor research pilot inExample13.
evidence_rows.limitation: A proposed transplant example does not document completed treated recipients or ex-vivo-only clinical benefit.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Keep proposed uses and completed observations separate.

evidence_rows.observation: FDA P180014 identifies the XPS/STEEN combination for assessment of initially unacceptable donor lungs; original approval2019-04-26.
evidence_rows.exact_article: XPS with STEEN, without an inferred AAT addition
evidence_rows.limitation: The base page warns that supplements can change labeling; complete present system requirements are not audited here.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Commercial development must fit an existing regulated perfusion workflow, with its own data and integration dependencies.

evidence_rows.observation: S012 concerns gas-monitor sensor sterilization; S014's2026-09-16 approval concerns a cannula luer-cap supplier/material change.
evidence_rows.limitation: These are not AAT clinical/product approvals; unread supplement contents are not inferred.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Recent platform dates cannot serve as evidence of AAT regulatory de-risking.

evidence_rows.observation: XVIVO states US STEEN use with XPS and describes up-to5h US acellular approval while distinguishing longer clinical-evidence durations.
evidence_rows.limitation: No universal time limit or prohibition is inferred, and12h AAT research does not inherit the description as its clinical product qualification.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Intended duration/configuration belongs to later product integration and cannot be assumed from a research circuit.

evidence_rows.observation: A reproducible activity/compatibility specification, differentiated process or controlled data package could have value to a supplier/operator; ddiscov's retained share requires a credible product/data/contract route.
evidence_rows.limitation: No owner terms, exclusivity, regulatory data reliance, license field, price, purchase or partnership was obtained.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Assess the information bought and follow-on economics; scientific usefulness alone does not establish a privately retained asset.

evidence_rows.observation: The original independent review ranks AAT seventh and assigns an illustrative US$30–100k/2–4month initial formulation/potency/process qualification tranche, excluding scarce organs and transplant validation.
evidence_rows.limitation: This is a judgmental envelope, not a quote or commitment. Qualification is the original tranche, not a substitute for an originally priced human-function study.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not import P2's different scope objection or require completed graft-benefit evidence before valuing qualification.

evidence_rows.observation: Qualification is useful only if it can change a later continuation decision; later organ validation and retained economics must be considered when choosing its scope.
evidence_rows.limitation: No numerical EV, NPV, probability or replacement allocation was computed.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain the conditional qualification option, stop repeated desktop work absent a concrete decision-changing artifact, and keep waiting available.

claim_decisions.claim: The approved starting product makes the AAT EVLP product already qualified.
The US application page establishes either a currently pending enforceable right or freedom to operate.
Round22 discovered previously unknown AU/KR grant existence.
The entire family has the broad US published claim scope or one universal70-claim count.
The UHN trial record or patent clinical example proves ex-vivo-only clinical efficacy.
Qualification-only work necessarily falls short of AAT's original next-dollar tranche.
A differentiated specification or process can have conditional economic value without proven ownership of an exclusive drug.
Full transplant validation and final commercial licenses must already exist before any informative qualification can be considered.
The bounded review establishes an executable investment, clinical product or numerical expected return.

rights_records.key_claim: Claim1 English machine rendering: normothermic AAT perfusion of a ventilated lung

marginal_decision.recommendation: Retain the conditional AAT initial-qualification option; close this bounded public product/rights pass at the recorded evidence ceiling.
marginal_decision.information_bought: Determine whether a specified manufactured article and perfusion process can deliver interpretable functional potency and compatibility, cheaply enough to make later organ validation worth considering.
marginal_decision.follow_on_value: More usable grafts or better graft function with a credible retained economic share.
do_not_assume: full program financed by the qualification envelope
potential_contribution_inference: contractual share or licensed development route
reopen_for: current primary prosecution/title/maintenance evidence affecting a specific route
full UHN protocol or results identifying route and outcomes
specific supply/access/rights/cost fact changing the next commitment
qualified product or workflow evidence changing later validation feasibility
